messages:
alex: Starting canary for osmium14b (int4). Running longform QA + summarization. Seeing sporadic OOMs and p95 jitter when clients request >700 tokens. Posting quick notes + stderr.
ravi: Can you share the exact runtime flags and microbench link?
alex: Runtime: microbatch=1, batch=6, prefetch_window=200, prefetch_padding=0, max_new_tokens=1200. Artifact: s3://bench/osmium14b/int4/canary-2026-03-29.
kai: Paste from worker logs: ```RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory allocating 1.4 GiB
slab_allocator: contiguous_free=704MB total_free=2.2GB
Stack: slab.cc:398 -> kv_store.cc:172 -> decoder.cc:101
Timeline: prefetch->kv_populate->attn_kv_alloc->decode```
ben: That ratio contiguous_free vs total_free is classic fragmentation. Two orthogonal fixes: conservative canary defaults + runtime compaction/evict fallback.
alex: Quick repro: `./run_canary --model osmium14b --quant int4 --prefetch 200 --max_new 1200 --requests 800` -> ~3 OOMs. Changing to `--prefetch 48 --max_new 512` -> 0 OOMs, p95 down ~15%.
ravi: Proposal: for new int4 variants set model_config.defaults: max_new_tokens=512, prefetch_window=48, prefetch_padding=32. Add runtime: on allocation failure try slab-compact for up to 120ms, then soft-evict upto 20% oldest KV pages before failing. Gate both behind feature flag.
kai: I ran slab-compact prototype on canary (ff on): 1k requests, p95 +2.5%, OOMs -> 0. Quality: ROUGE-L -2.8 vs fp16, BERTScore -0.012.
ben: I'll open PR for compact-on-failure + metric telemetry (compact_attempts, reclaimed_bytes). If compact rate high we'll revise prefetch heuristics.
deploy-bot: :rocket: canary deploy started: osmium14b-int4 -> pool-canary-5
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary pod 5 ready (v2026-03-29-int4-slab-ff)
alex: Action items: (1) keep canary defaults conservative, (2) land compact PR behind flag, (3) run full 10k sweep with metrics: p50/p95/p99, OOM count, ROUGE/BERTScore, cost/token. If quality delta <=2 pts and perf hit <=5% we promote.
ravi: Filed ML-1624: "osmium14b int4 onboard: conservative defaults + slab-compact fallback".
alex: Thanks team 44d. Will post sweep artifacts and update the ticket.
